{{Quote|Makkor von Urron was a double TIE ace by age 18, racking up 11 kills against insurgent Y-wings around Oovri II before a lucky shot took out his knee and put him out of action.|''Aces of the Empire''|<ref name="TEGtWAC10" />}}
The '''Battle of Oovri II''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] engagement around [[Oovri II]]. Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] fought insurgent [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Makkor von Urron]] became a double [[Ace/Legends|ace]] by killing 11 enemy fighters himself. He would later join the elite [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]].<ref name="TEGtWAC10" />
